title: ForbiddenLogKeyRegistry
description: Forbidden log key words (planning/11 §8, planning/14 §2): the one list the API logger, the worker logger, the forbidden-field lint and their drift checks read. Each entry is one lowercase word; a log key is forbidden when any of its camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case words equals an entry. Add words freely; removing one weakens redaction and needs a security-privacy review.
